claims.gist: Evaluations place vendors on ability-to-execute and completeness-of-vision axes
Four vendor categories describe position in the evaluation, not overall quality
Vendors do not pay for inclusion or placement
Analysts score independently and a review panel calibrates scores before publication
A Niche Player can be the best choice for a buyer with specific needs
The evaluation is a snapshot, and markets change quickly
The evaluation does not measure fit with your environment, budget or technology
Start from your own requirements, not the graphic, and include a non-Leader if it fits

thesis: Vendor evaluations are snapshots of relative position; buyers should start from their own requirements and validate.
